name: Camp Laurel Wood Day Camp
operator_name: Girl Scouts of Central & Western Massachusetts
description_short: Girl Scout day camp in Spencer open to all girls, with or without Girl Scout experience. Campers swim at the waterfront, canoe, paddle boat, try archery and a low challenge course, and learn outdoor skills around a weekly theme.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing four weeks or more before the session for a refund minus the $75 deposit; no refunds within four weeks or for missed days, with partial or full refunds possible for documented medical emergencies.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp Laurel Wood day camp, Spencer: open to all girls, Monday to Friday 9:00 am to 4:30 pm, bring lunch; bus for $100 a week from fixed stops; 2026 sessions 1 to 6 from the bus table; non members pay an extra $55 membership fee. The page says Camp Laurel Wood has not gone through ACA accreditation.
Researched by Claude from this page. Summer camp page: day camp is for campers who have finished kindergarten and up; Camp Laurel Wood, Spencer MA; camp financial assistance offered every year.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Day Camp Family Handbook: Camp Laurel Wood camp cell 413-727-5740, CLWDirector@gscwm.org, available June 29 to August 7. The handbook gives the physical address as 63 Buteau Rd in its contact list but 34 Buteau Rd in its directions, so street_address is left out.
